Question: I'm a topper in my college but my roommate, the only one whom I believe so much, gets jealous of me. How can I react to this situation?
Answer: Congrats on being a college topper. Your reaction to others jealousy can be by being blind, deaf and dumb to it . Humans show jealousy, envy, anger and hatred. You are above human if you are able to ignore these things in others. Laugh to yourself if you see envy around you. We all may feel jealous of others sometimes. But there is no need to show it out and spoil relationships. A good human keeps all these negative emotions in control. And soon comes out of it with only a positive outlook everywhere. So if your best friend /room mate /classmate /relative / even sibling is jealous of you, start giving them lesser information about you hereafter. Do not talk about your goals, the process, your achievements etc. Much as you desperately want someone to share this joy, keep them to yourself. No point making others feel jealousy and hatred towards you lest they start harming you, your good name and your progressive activities. Only achievers know this pain. I have been in such situations in my life too. Friends turning into foes, cousins foul mouthing you and relatives spreading defaming rumours..these were common in my college years. Initially it hurts. But soon we learn to face this crap. So keeping your goals, achievements unknown to others applies not only in student life but right upto senior years. Nobody is happy with your progress and your happiness. Live your life and let them see. Do not talk about it. Have the last laugh, that too secretly. Life's like that.. 😃 12.12.23

Name: Bhuvana Rameshwar
Question: Can one live happily without social media?
Answer: Yes, yes, yes. We went to New Zealand from Sydney on a 5 days tour (with one day more gone for flights and time difference) . I wanted a break from all social media including Google search, news, maps, WhatsApp, telegram, Quora, Fb. I'm not on Instagram, X and other apps. It was like a real vacation, taking a break from others except family members who were with me .. Husband, son, dil and granddaughter. My tickets, visa and hotel reservations were in paper printouts. Besides nowadays passport has all the information needed just by scanning them in airports. Things are now so easy and transparent. I used my phone only as a camera. Didn't carry any iPad too. Just one 9 by 9inches handbag to carry the camera - phone, some mint and tissue. That's all. No burden like all others who had shoulder bags! It was peaceful all the 5 + days. My friends and extended family knew we were away for 5+ days so no worries or searching me as “missing person” . I enjoyed nature at its best. I gained time. I had no delays. I had no neck pain or shoulder pain. I enjoyed the tour. This is not the first time I did this kind of escape. I do that often whenever on tours, both inland or abroad. Besides nobody believe me, is interested in your tour photos. So humility helps in getting full happiness. No expectations for likes , no comments, no snubs, no fake praises, no criticisms, no anxiety means absolute peace. Try it. It is so relaxing, having time all for yourself is a boon. 18.3.24

Question: Why do people fear being alone even though they may be unhappy in their current relationships?
Answer: Many fear being alone inspite of being in an unhappy relationship because they fear multiple things at a time.. This is common in countries where education, career, new jobs available and economic levels are lower. This is more so in women of developing countries like India, Pakistan etc For them going back to parents is also a problem. Most parents get their daughters married off and do not want them coming back as singles due to social stigma. Many families do not want even widowed daughters back. One notorious example is Brindavan temple city in India where widows are brought and abandoned to fend for themselves by their own families . Most land in wrong hands. (sex racketeers) Getting out of unhappy relationships means starting a new one . Many prefer a known devil to an unknown angel. They get used to it and do not want to come out of this comfort zone. Moreover starting life once again with often a new job, new house, new town seems a tough job. If they have good savings it is easier to break up. Otherwise they feel it is better to continue in the current one they already got used to even if not very happy…as long as there is some money in hand, food, home and clothes. They literally give up on life and lead a monotonous life. The change scares them. For them everything else in life is fine for their happiness except their spouse /partner, which they sacrifice for sake of continuity, least disturbance in life and find fillup joys in other things like their children, jobs, daily entertainments, friends, partying, touring, hobbies, social life and social events. 6.8.24

Name: Bhuvana Rameshwar
Question: What is the life expectancy of an apartment in Chennai?
Answer: Around 50 years plus or minus 5 years depending on the quality of its construction. We had an apartment in Chennai. It was in a prime area of Nungambakkam. Bought it in 1988, our first purchase on an office loan, cost Rs 3.5 L. We used it for 4 years when son and I stayed there for his very crucial 9th to 12th grade school education. After that only tenants stayed there. Our apartment wasn't taken care of by the numerous tenants. It looked pathetic with stained kitchen, washrooms and termites eating away wooden doors, leaking pipes. This is inspite of regular repairs and full professional cleaning, painting and acid washing of bathrooms whenever tenants changed. The last tenant was the worst of them all. Finally by 2018 we wanted to dispose it. By now it was 30 years old. There were many proposals to sell , demolish the full sixteen apartments and rebuild with each owner getting a new apartment and the builder getting a whole new floor added. But many owners refused to shift out fearing the usual delays in construction. Some were old and weak. My professor is an owner there. Meanwhile our flat fetched only a pathetic price of Rs 54 L maximum. We felt bad seeing our first purchase in such a dilapidated condition. It needed a complete rejuvenation. We owed our dear house this. So we changed the bath tiles, accessories, floor tiles, doors, all closets, got it painted . Now it looked brand new. Immediately we got a buyer for Rs 70 L. Luckily the construction quality of the pillars, columns of the 80s was good. People are still living there and will continue for another 15 years easily. 16.6.24

Question: One side my MIL says this is your house and then she expects I discuss or ask her before calling my relatives home for lunch or dinner. How correct is it?

This is basic manners as it is your inlaws’ house. Second in case you need to clean up the house or get some snacks, soft drinks or milk for coffee or special veg, sea food etc. This helps in mental and physical preparation besides you can also reschedule if needed if there are other plans. And I'm sorry to say I do not entertain guests who have insulted my husband, son or made fun of my grand daughter. Mind you, there are few such people unknown to my dil from our side as well as her people. Such people are most unwelcome. Here the lime juice works ! Sometimes nothing at all. This is the main difference between inlaws’ house and your own nuclear house although both are “ this is your house, dear ”. 12.2.24.

Question: How do I make a non-vegetarian cake at home?
Answer: Most cakes are made with eggs. Eggs are non vegetarian. Any simple cake recipe asks for eggs so it is naturally a non vegetarian food unless you specifically want a vegetarian cake and eggs are replaced with condensed milk or yoghurt . Another is not a “sweet “cake but a savoury type. Here you add shredded, cooked chicken pieces and cheese into the egg and butter/oil creamy mix . Instead of sugar add a little salt and little pepper powder with any suitable spice as you wish like Cinnamon, nutmeg or Oregano Rosemary Chilli flakes, Garlic powder Chopped coriander, finely chopped onions, capsicum etc As per your liking Then mix in the dry ingredients like refined flour, baking powder and baking soda. Bake. Non vegetarian cake is done. Try it out. This cake doesn't need any sweet icing, but you can apply a layer of creamy cheese and decorate with onion, tomato slices, chopped coriander leaves or basil leaves . Have with tomato sauce or mint chutney. 6.5.24

Question: Which is better on holidays, a travel vacation or a family reunion?
Answer: I have had both the above in our vacation days. When in laws were alive we gathered every vacation.. Parents inlaw, all brothers and sisters and their families. My fil made sure we all attended, gathered at home but we went on some out of town visits sometimes temples sometime seashore with packed food. Sometimes we also had family reunions in some nearby holiday spots like our default vacation spot mammalapuram. Sea bath, sea food, lots chatting, playing in the beach was real fun. There was fun but those living far away had to make travel arrangements well in advance. Get togethers at homes meant feast, more work for women especially those good in cooking and those younger in age. The others chatted, asking for hourly snacks, tea, juice etc. By the end of the trip we hurriedly packed our bags and rushed to the railway station, all tired mentally and physically with thoughts of the journey back home and the monotonous routine life once again. The family reunion trip was fun for children as they got to meet cousins, relatives and a happy one for the grandparents. But I somehow felt too tired mentally as we were invariably subjected to lots of gossip, complaints and family politics. Some misunderstandings too would crop up. It was very obvious that the smart ones neither worked nor helped out with the expenditure. But those were days when people had respect for parents /parents inlaw. But now with them dead we do not enjoy those fake family get togethers much. We attend one or two per year may be as family weddings or some birthday party. But now the number of inland tours and foreign trips have increased . These are more fun. Not much work as stay, travel and food are all taken care off . In my family we are all travel buffs. So the enjoyment is more. We learn more about known places and get to see new places too. Each place is a new learning… in science, architecture, history, political views geography, new cities , new culture, new food, new people.. The list is endless. Photography is our passion too. So anytime I choose vacation travel over family get togethers. 13.12.23

Question: What should you do if you accidentally book the wrong flight with the wrong date and time?
Answer: Cancel everything and rebook in the same airlines. This saves money. Changing airlines means you get back may be 25 percent of the money at the most. There is no other way because many airlines do let you pre or postpone the trip with minimum cancellation charges. Some airlines allow one postponing or one preponing without any charges too . Most discounted tickets are non - cancellable if you read the fine print. So check your ticket and change your ticket ASAP hoping you do not lose money as cancellation charges. Any delay results in more cancellation charges. Any delay results in higher rates of tickets that are to be booked. Next time be careful especially with” am /pm” and auto predicting dates and months. 7.3.24

Question: What do you do when you're home alone and out of toilet paper?
Answer: If alone and out of toilet paper I have to wash with water from the shower. No other choice. But what if there is no water, no tap as in some only closet cabinets, with bath cubicle separate ? We are now in Sydney, Australia. I have lived abroad in my teen years and travelled abroad too using toilet paper for cleaning as the western culture does. In India we have a special small toilet shower (bidet) for that purpose. But this Sydney apartment doesn't have one. Only toilet paper, kept stacked. A few days I tolerated the paper and immediately had my bath to feel clean. We don't know, where to get buckets and mugs in Sydney. Even the Indian and Chinese shops couldn't help. But now I use these .. A mini bucket and a Greek curd container as mug. So we add 2 or 3 mugs of water to the bucket after using so it is never empty. And we got back the freedom to use the toilet in emergency and IBS. This gives us freedom from the toilet paper. Question: What is the importance of Sambar powder in South Indian cuisine? What will happen if it's missing from our kitchen shelves?
Answer: Sambar powder is used for all types of sambars, non dhal gravies, veg fries and sea food gravies and fries. If sambar powder is missing from our shelf we can make one easily at home by dry frying red chilies, coriander seeds, little yellow gram, little black gram, cumin seeds, pepper corns, fenugreek seeds, curry leaves, fried asafoetida, cooling them and then dry grinding them together. For ratios.. check a cookery book or online recipe. Or wet grinding them in a small mixie. For sambar used for serving with idkues, dosa, pongal, vada etc grind some roast coconut pieces for that extra flavour. Also grind it slightly coarser. Suppose you do not have time then what to do for that day’s sambar making. Simple.. add two table sp of coriander powder, two tbsp of chilly powder, 1/4 tea spoon of cumin powder, 1/4 tea spoon of pepper powder, 1/4 tsp of turmeric powder, 1/4 tea spoon of asafoetida in a bowl. Mix well and keep. Use this as instant sambar powder. For tempering use a little medium hot oil.. Fry in it mustard seeds, a few broken red chillies, cumin seeds, a little fenugreek and curry leaves. Sambar smells excellent. 6.12.23

Question: What are some ways to fix an irregular sleeping pattern after staying up late for several days in a row?

If sleeping at 9 pm have food by 8 pm. Eat a high protein food together with starchy foods like potatoes, rice or bread. Drink warm water after meal times. Question: Can both people in a marriage (husband & wife) want a divorce but not have any idea why they should end their marriage?
Answer: Yes. Sometimes some pairs just cannot connect. Even those once in love fall out of love after a few years because of lack of time together or distance. They do not fight, do not cheat on each other, there is no physical or mental abuse, there is no terminal illness and yet couples drift apart. The marriage become a barren desert, with no life or laughter in it. They are both good people but with different wave lengths so they couldn't love or like each other for that “happiness “ which a happy marriage gives couples. They may respect each other or tolerate each other but otherwise have no common interests, no common thoughts and views and there is no emotional connection between them.. Such couples may find somebody else as soul mates and hence moving away is the best for either of them. Such couples go in for fast mutual divorce without any drama, fights and melodrama. Usually such separations happen in childless couples or after adult children are well settled in life. And they do not regret the marriage or divorce. Just move away for the good of both. 3.12.23.
